families.allocation_algorithm: Equal weight selected ETFs, then scale by target_portfolio_volatility divided by lagged covariance volatility.
families.baseline_distinction: Adds relative ranking and portfolio-level volatility scaling under a hard unlevered cap.
families.cash_rule: No eligible ETF means 100% cash; exposure below 1.0 leaves residual cash.
families.economic_mechanism: Relative momentum selection may capture persistence while lagged portfolio-volatility scaling limits exposure in unstable states.
families.execution_timing_rule: A signal formed on session t executes only on the next eligible session.
long_only_no_leverage_invariants: sum of risky weights is at most 1.0
families.ranking_algorithm: Sort descending score then ascending symbol and select fixed top_k.
families.rebalance_rule: Recompute every fixed 21 observations from the first scored session.
families.regime_partition_algorithm: Lagged signs and relative returns only; no boundary is fit from TRAIN or VALIDATION.
families.risk_rule: Scale is finite, nonnegative, and capped so gross exposure never exceeds 1.0.
families.signal_algorithm: At t, compute each ETF's lookback_sessions trailing return and admit only positive scores.
families.warmup_rule: Earlier TRAIN closes may initialize return and covariance indicators only; no fit or P&L carryover.

families.economic_mechanism: A slow own-price trend filter may avoid prolonged declines while inverse volatility diversifies admitted exposures.
families.execution_timing_rule: A signal formed on session t executes only on the next eligible session.
long_only_no_leverage_invariants: sum of risky weights is at most 1.0
families.ranking_algorithm: NOT_APPLICABLE; process admitted symbols in ascending symbol order.
families.rebalance_rule: Recompute every parameterized rebalance_sessions from the first scored session.
families.regime_partition_algorithm: Lagged signs and relative returns only; no boundary is fit from TRAIN or VALIDATION.
families.risk_rule: Finite positive volatility required; no short, leverage, or gross exposure above 1.0.
families.signal_algorithm: At t, admit each ETF only when lagged close is strictly above its trend_window simple moving average.
families.warmup_rule: Earlier TRAIN closes may initialize moving-average and volatility indicators only; no fit or P&L carryover.
